Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you very much for taking the time to share such a detailed and thoughtful review of your experience at &More by Sheraton.

We will certainly share your kind recognition with Duyen and the entire team.

Thank you again for your kind words and for recognizing the small details that make a difference. We look forward to welcoming you back to &More by Sheraton for another warm and enjoyable experience.

Warm regards,

I was gonna whinge till I tried my food
Sep 2024 • Solo
I ordered my drink and croissant and nearly fainted at the price. I nearly fell off my pretend chair. I was thinking right that’s it thoa is crap. I will review that. HOWEVER, when the food came out the iced coconut coffee was so pretty and when I tasted it, wow wow wow. The croissant was nice too. The young lady who served me oanh Lucy was just lovely. Being the only person in the cafe as it’s late, we struck a conversation and I gave her feedback that it was the best coconut I had to date. She asked if I had tried salted coffee which I had but only the hot version. She said she would give me a sample of the cold. Oh Lordy that was beautiful too. The cream looks slightly green but don’t let that deter you. So is the food pricy, yes. Is it worth it , I would have to say yes! The place is clean, the vibe is cruisy yet styled but more than anything it’s fantastic helpful service and great food. Highly recommended!
